protocol_requirement: Rerun at least one complete accepted Stage-8 seed in a clean environment under the exact historical execution/config identity. Verification evidence only; current Stage-9.5 head may not substitute for the historical checkout.

blocking_dependency.reason: The complete accepted Stage-8 seed rerun requires the exact frozen System-A checkpoint bytes. Those bytes are not present in Git, retained provenance-critical Actions artifacts, GitHub releases, or the current project session. Regenerating or retraining System A would violate the byte-identity requirement.

other_reconstruction_inputs.raw_data_note: The eight exact raw CICIDS2017 CSV files have independently verified byte hashes in the current project context. A clean rerun still requires an external heavy-data handoff/archive, but raw-data identity is not the immediate stopping condition.

prohibited_resolution: retrain System A and substitute newly serialized checkpoints
execute from the current Stage-9.5 head instead of the required historical execution identity
treat numerical equivalence as checkpoint byte identity unless an original stored artifact explicitly predeclared that equivalence
permitted_resolution: Recover the five original checkpoint files from an authoritative archive and verify every frozen SHA-256 before rerunning a complete Stage-8 seed in the historical checkout/environment.
interpretation: This blocks clean deterministic historical rerun evidence. It does not establish a numerical mismatch in the already accepted Stage-8/9 compact evidence.
